fine_lines.title: What does he look like? vs What is he like?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: What does he look like? تسأل عن الشكل (الشعر، العيون، الطول). أما What is he like? فتسأل عن الشخصية.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "What does he look like?" asks about appearance. "What is he like?" asks about personality.

examples.sentence: What does he look like? He has short, blond hair.
What is he like? He's very friendly.

fine_lines.title: has vs is
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم has مع الشعر والعيون (He has blue eyes)، ونستخدم is مع الطول (He is tall). وفي الماضي: had و was.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use has for hair and eyes; use is for height. In the past: had and was.

fine_lines.title: short vs long vs tall
fine_lines.explanation_ar: short لها معنيان: شعر قصير (عكس long) وشخص قصير (عكس tall). نستخدم long للشعر وtall للأشخاص.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Short has two opposites: long (for hair) and tall (for people).

examples.sentence: He has short hair, and he is short.

fine_lines.title: curly vs straight
fine_lines.explanation_ar: curly = شعر مجعد، straight = شعر ناعم مستقيم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Curly hair has curves; straight hair has no curves.

grammar.title: Describing appearance: has / is
grammar.explanation_ar: للشعر والعيون نستخدم has (أو have مع I/you): He has blue eyes. وللطول نستخدم is: He is tall. ويمكن وضع عدة صفات قبل hair: short, blond, curly hair.
grammar.explanation_en: Use has/have for hair and eyes, and be for height. You can put several adjectives before hair.
examples: He has short, blond, curly hair.
She has long, straight, brown hair and blue eyes.
I have blue eyes. I'm short.

grammar.title: Describing in the past: had / was
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نصف شخصًا رأيناه في الماضي نستخدم had بدل has، وwas بدل is. والسؤال: What did he look like? Did he have ...? Was he ...?
grammar.explanation_en: For the past, use had (not has) and was (not is). Questions: What did he look like? Did he have ...? Was he ...?
examples: What did she look like? She had long hair.
Did he have curly hair or straight hair? He had curly hair.
Was she tall or short? She was short.

grammar.title: Choice questions with or
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل سؤال اختيار بـ or، والجواب يختار واحدًا: Was it a man or a woman? It was a man.
grammar.explanation_en: Use or to give a choice; the answer picks one.
examples: Was it a man or a woman?
Did she have curly hair or straight hair?
